about_the_game:
Dracula has been resurrected in modern nights Los Angeles. Separated from his home by oceans and time itself, he must come to grips with a new world while his survival hangs in the balance.

Harrowed World: Dracula Fallen is a work of interactive horror fiction offering a quiet descent into the dark. No music stirs, no voices speak, no light intrudes. You are left alone with only the text and the echoes from the dark recesses of your mind.

 

The New Order of the Dragon has brought Dracula back from his second death with a long-forgotten ritual from the forbidden tomes of Scholomance but things are not all that they seem.

In Hollywood, yet another adaption of Bram Stoker’s novel is being made, and Dracula must come to terms with the unexpected fame that the author has bestowed upon him.

  • Paths of Darkness: Experience 'Harrowed World: Dracula Fallen' through two distinct character paths.

  • Dracula’s Path: Assume the mantle of the ancient undead warlord taking on the world of today in Dracula's Path

  • Carmen’s Path: Explore Los Angeles through eyes of a modern vampire and become the leader of the New Order of the Dragon in Carmen's Path.

  • Blood Is The Life: Take advantage of feeding opportunities.

  • Draconic Powers: Make use of your vampiric abilities.

  • Dracula's Path Duration: TBD.

  • Carmen's Path Duration: TBD.

  • Dark Conclusions: Uncover multiple different endings.

  • Voice of the Dragon: Assistive self-voicing is included for those who need support following the story.

  • Additional Systems: Explore the Internal Achievements and Lexicon Systems.

  • Supported: Controller Support (partially tested) and Mac and Linux Support (untested).

A dark and twisted version of our world where supernatural creatures hide among humanity. Vampires, magical folk, and other beings compete for power and influence through secret societies, corporate power, and religious sects.

Harrowed World takes creatures of myth and folklore reimagining them as concealed predators and tricksters. This vision of the world is dystopian and bleak with both human and inhuman horrors, but most people are blissfully ignorant of the dark forces at work around them.

Harrowed World is the shared setting and franchise of a growing number of video games and (soon) books, combing elements of gothic horror, adventure, dystopian fiction, drama, science fiction, Lovecraftian horror, and urban fantasy. Experience Harrowed World from a variety of perspectives from the prowling vampire to the monster hunting Beholder.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game revolves around vampires in a horror setting and will contain many depictions or references to many amoral, sensitive, disturbing, and monstrous things, such as drinking blood, murder, manipulation, exploitation, suicide, abuse, and religion. This is not an excuse to be a monster yourself.

Due to the use of a historical protagonist in a modern setting, the game may contain references to old fashioned attitudes that may not match modern sensibilities.  

This game is not suitable for those who are easily offended or upset by such content.

detailed_description:
WANT MORE VAMPIRE GAMES?

Harrowed World is the shared setting and franchise of a growing number of video games and (soon) books.

Check out our FREE gothic vampire visual novel, that acts a precursor to this very game. Find 'Harrowed World: What's Past Is Portents' and other Harrowed World games using the 'Check out the entire Harrowed World collection on Steam' link above.

Step into a dark and unforgiving world where vampires pull the strings of humanity. You are not the hero, you are not the villain, you are nothing but a pawn in schemes that you cannot even begin to understand. Some things are better left secret, kept hidden away from prying eyes.

Wishlist 'Harrowed World: Portents In Red', our modern gothic vampire RPG and check out other Harrowed World games using the 'Check out the entire Harrowed World collection on Steam' link above.

You died and have been brought back as a vampire. Left abandoned by the one responsible, you must learn to survive the treachery of your vampiric peers and satisfy the gnawing thirst and hunger within. The portents in red. What do they mean? Only you can find out.
